title: Certificate of registration.
bodyText: Each certificate of registration shall be in a form prescribed and signed by the director, and shall be issued in the name of the department.
bodyHtml: [§443B-4.51]  Certificate of registration.  Each certificate of registration shall be in a form prescribed and signed by the director, and shall be issued in the name of the department. [L 1990, c 246, pt of §1]
